title: Define monitoring, review cycles and public reporting in governance
requirements:
- Extend operational monitoring to point-of-care consequences (workarounds, delayed care, near misses)
- Explain how technical, API/profile, terminology/model and policy releases relate and are coordinated
- Set a review cadence and extraordinary-review triggers for governance arrangements
- Replace disclosure to 'appropriate stakeholders' with a presumption of public disclosure and limited exceptions
- Recommend that expanding the purposes of the infrastructure be decided at the level that established it
- Describe a continuous learning-and-monitoring capability for safety-critical components, not only AI (drift, bias, incidents)
- Require measurable acceptance criteria and independent or governance-approved verification for critical releases
- Describe a recurring architecture-management cycle for continuous evolution in Phase 4
